newsitem.title: UK: Mentmore tumbles after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Mentmore tumbles after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Mentmore Abbey Plc plummeted on Wednesday after the storage-to-Platignum pens group warned that trading at its recently-acquired British Data Management (BDM) unit was well below expectations.

Mentmore said it would take a one-off charge of 1 million stg to cover rationalisation costs at BDM, and would also make a balance sheet adjustment of 11 million stg to reflect more prudent accounting measures at the unit.
"BDM will not in the short term deliver the profits expected at the time of acquisition," said Mentmore chairman Nick Smith.
"However, we remain confident that the underlying business with the appropriate management will in time deliver the expected benefits."
Before the exceptional charge, Mentmore profits jumped to 1.31 million stg in the first half ended October 31 from 36,000 stg a year before.
Mentmore shares were down 27p at 56-1/2 by 1418 GMT in volume of 1.9 million shares.
